caption: The drawing depicts a quilt folded neatly to display its patterned corner, with an additional close-up section of the quilt shown below for detail. The quilt features an intricate design composed mainly of red and green elements on a white or light background. The central motif consists of a large red flower with eight petals surrounded by green leaves and smaller green and red floral shapes arranged symmetrically. A border surrounds this main motif, decorated with an undulating green vine bearing red and green floral or leaf shapes and small clusters of red dots. The quilt’s outer edge has a double border, the inner being red and the outer being green. In the lower right corner of the quilt, the text “J. & COVENTRY.” is visible, written in red capital letters. The close-up inset at the bottom right zooms in on a portion of the green and red leaf designs and the lettering, emphasizing the texture and stitching of the fabric, as well as the details of the applique work. The colors used throughout are vivid red and green contrasted against the lighter background, giving clear definition to the shapes and lettering.
title: Pepperberry Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
